label: Storybook gouache
description: Opaque gouache painted on textured paper: soft brush edges, visible strokes, a warm limited palette and gentle light. A picture book that moves.
suits: stories, faith and reflection, folklore, gentle explainers
image: hand-painted gouache illustration on cold-press paper, visible opaque brush strokes and dry-brush texture, soft painted edges rather than outlines, simplified shapes with carefully chosen detail, a warm limited palette, painterly skies, a picture-book finish
light: soft directional light with warm highlights and cool painted shadows
camera: unhurried: slow push-ins, gentle lateral drifts, an occasional slow crane
motion: hand-painted 2D animation: the brush texture stays on the paper while forms move, gentle secondary motion in hair, cloth, leaves and steam, soft easing
avoid: photorealism, 3D render, glossy plastic, hard vector outlines, lens flare
